about: Owner-editable availability report for the NCAAF model's move breakdown. College football has no official injury feed, so entries are added by hand. One row per player per game (gid = ESPN game id, team = ESPN team id). status: out | suspended | dismissed (all = out), doubtful (0.75 out), questionable | gtd (0.5), limited (0.25), probable (0.1), active (0). RB / WR / TE rows are valued as P(out) x his share of carries / catches over the last 3 games, using the tested lead back / receiver coefficients; other positions are listed but not valued. Off-field items count only for availability: an arrest with no suspension is 'active' (no effect). A file with the same shape at <DATA_DIR>/ncaaf/ncaaf-vas/player-status.json (on the volume) overrides rows here.
